method: Web search plus visual inspection of all nine kr2b gallery slides, 2GIS map/indoor plan, two individual 2GIS exterior photos, FotoPlaneta and an El.kz exterior photograph in separate Chrome research tabs. No photographs are redistributed with the model.
model_status: Reference-informed original exterior reconstruction; conceptual scale remains true. Not a measured or survey-grade digital twin.

sources.dates: Project 2012–2018; a design sheet visibly dated 07/08/2013. Individual photographs undated.
sources.facts: Project area stated as 70,000 sqm; brick is identified as principal facade material. The gallery mixes construction photographs, completed-detail photographs, interior photographs and early conceptual renderings. It does not supply an exterior survey or measured footprint.
visually_confirmed: Construction photograph: tall rectangular entrance tower, pointed arch, small projecting brick blocks in regular rows and cream blind infill in the smaller arches.
Completed entrance close-up: deep pointed opening, large pale scrolling ornamental screen, glazed entrance below; screen is not a diagonal diamond lattice.
Cladding close-up: brown brick panels, cream brick infill, narrow dark joints, raised small rectangular blocks. No white outline around every facade arch.
sources.limits: Early renderings show AVM TARAZ and speculative international retail logos; these are not evidence of current tenants, signage or built details. Roof and rear geometry are not comprehensively documented.
sources.rights: Copyright kr2b; no open image licence found. External reference only.

sources.type: Cartographic building card and visual indoor plan
sources.facts: Card identifies Tole bi 27, Taraz, and 4 floors. Map exposes floor selectors 0–4. Extended rectangular footprint is visibly divided into several inset/protruding volumes. The retail complex lies between the road-facing frontage and the long landscaped/canal side.
sources.ratios: Visual footprint estimate length/depth roughly 2.6–2.9, medium confidence; perspective map view and schematic outline prevent precise measurement. Main entrance is off-centre in the long frontage.
sources.limits: Floor selector and tenant labels are reference context only, not permission to assert current stall numbering or navigation. Cartographic outline is schematic; no exact metre dimensions recovered.
sources.rights: 2GIS cartography and contributed photos retain their respective rights; do not redistribute tiles or images.

sources.author: erkerke
sources.visually_confirmed: Oblique view from the small-arch side: tall brown entrance tower; lower repeated narrow arches with cream solid infill; glazing confined to bottom zone; dark base; stepped facade heights; projecting square brick relief; simple paved forecourt, small trees and slim dark lamps.
sources.limits: Photo publication date is not necessarily capture date. Perspective prevents exact dimensions; cropped view does not prove complete bay count.
sources.rights: No open licence established. External reference only.

sources.author: Umayka Maksatkyzy
sources.visually_confirmed: Tall advertising wall on the left of the entrance with pale brick side returns, dark horizontal/vertical divisions, large ground-floor glazing and a dark base. Facade is asymmetric. Night lighting changes apparent colour.
sources.limits: Brand panels change over time. Logos should not be copied into geometry; use a neutral advertising-panel rhythm and HTML venue label.
sources.rights: No open licence established. External reference only.

sources.author: Сергей Мурзин
sources.visually_confirmed: Four small arched bays to the right of a pale connector and the main portal are individually visible. Their upper arches are cream solid brick, with storefront glazing below. Brown friezes have relief blocks; a continuous grey upper mass rises behind. The entrance portal has a broad brown cap and large pointed recess, not a classical white arch trim.
sources.limits: Right end of full complex is cropped; no rear, roof or exact dimensions. Camera perspective exaggerates nearest bay widths.
sources.rights: Site requires an active source link if photo is reused; no open licence established. Photo is not included in delivery.

sources.visually_confirmed: Opposite oblique exterior view verifies the tall pointed entrance, four small arched blind bays and a lower right wing extending past them. The extended wing has an upper horizontal glass strip, pale horizontal fascia, repeated vertical piers and small pale ornamental panels. Grey upper cladding/plant enclosure runs behind the low facade. Main entrance screen consists of broad curls, with glazing and doors underneath.
sources.limits: Actual capture date unknown; lower wing is partially cropped. Exact complete repeated-panel count, roof plant and rear volumes remain unverified.
sources.rights: External reference only; no open image licence established.

modelling_brief.priority: Replace generic symmetric mall with a long asymmetric composition, deep pointed entrance, warm brown and cream brick fields, dark plinth and four blind-arch shopfront bays. Architectural colours should follow photographs, not Lime accent colours.
modelling_brief.footprint: Use a long low rectangular retail core, approximate length/depth 2.7. Portal is in left third of main frontage. Simple rear/roof remains explicitly an estimate.
modelling_brief.height_tiers: Main portal roughly 1.4–1.6 times lower arch-wing height. Advertising block at left lower than portal. Continuous recessed upper core/grey parapet behind lower facade. Avoid invented glass rooflights.
modelling_brief.entrance: Deep pointed arch cut into rectangular tower; broad cream intrados, dark recessed backing, pale scrolling screen suspended above glazed doors. Remove lime canopy and diagonal lattice from previous model.
modelling_brief.facade: Four small semicircular blind arches on the right, cream brick infill above ground-floor storefront glass. Thin dark panel joints and regularly spaced projecting brick blocks in upper brown friezes. An extended right wing has strip glazing, pale fascia and ornament-panel rhythm. Left advertising wall represented without copying tenant marks.
modelling_brief.scale_convention: Model units remain metres, but chosen dimensions are proportional modelling estimates. Keep conceptual_scale=true and explicitly avoid a 1:1 claim.
modelling_brief.budget: Target below 30,000 triangles and 1.5 MB. Small brick repeats use unbevelled solids; decorative screen uses original simplified flat ribbons. No photo textures, logos, external assets or decoder dependencies.
unverified_zones: Full right wing beyond photographic crop
